hooks.name: Lint and test on Python save
hooks.description: On save of any backend/app Python file, run ruff lint+format check and the matching unit test file.

action.command:
#!/usr/bin/env zsh
set -euo pipefail

# Parse the saved file path from hook stdin
SAVED_FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [[ -z "$SAVED_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "No file path received; skipping."
  exit 0
fi

WORKSPACE="/Users/dan/kiro/experiments/ReviewLens-AI"
cd "$WORKSPACE"

echo "=== ruff: $SAVED_FILE ==="
uv run ruff check "$SAVED_FILE"
uv run ruff format --check "$SAVED_FILE"

# Derive the corresponding unit test file
# backend/app/foo/bar.py -> tests/unit/foo/test_bar.py
REL="${SAVED_FILE#backend/app/}"          # foo/bar.py
DIR=$(dirname "$REL")                     # foo
BASE=$(basename "$REL" .py)               # bar
TEST_FILE="backend/tests/unit/${DIR}/test_${BASE}.py"

if [[ -f "$TEST_FILE" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "=== pytest: $TEST_FILE ==="
  uv run pytest "$TEST_FILE" -q
else
  echo ""
  echo "(no unit test file found at $TEST_FILE; skipping pytest)"
fi
